notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Now Available!
notes.content:
Hi, everyone!

I'm happy to announce that you now have access to the collectible cards of Road Defense: Outsiders!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289375/e27b569e8ef3f2763f3416539e9f0ec63d3ae35a.png[/img]

You can also try to collect all the game's badges and show how dedicated you are to keeping the highways protected. Furthermore, you can now get exclusive items from Road Defense: Outsiders, such as profile backgrounds, emoticons, and animated avatars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289375/0a75ca0aee9bcf59f477754f7197e010787e116a.png[/img]

I hope you enjoy the updates! All of this was only possible thanks to your support and dedication to the game!

Thanks!

notes.title: SHMUP Fest
notes.content:
Steam SHMUP Fest celebrates the spirit of timing, power-ups, and lots of bullets with discounts and demos on current and upcoming shoot 'em up games of all kinds.
This event runs September 25 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7) to October 2 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7) and will include discounting, as well as sections for games in Coming Soon and games with demos.

notes.title: I am pleased to inform you about the update v0.1.028 - EA 🎮🎉
notes.content:
Hello players! 👋

In this update, I have added a new menu where you can now create a new game or continue a game that you started previously. This feature allows you to start a new game and test the game's balancing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289375/49edadf14478e8fb48d9812ff0d0e3ce55148999.png[/img]

Please note that I am still working hard on balancing the game, so your feedback is always appreciated. I hope you enjoy this new update and have fun playing Road Defense: Outsiders.

Thank you for your continued support 😊🎮

notes.title: WATCH THE DEVELOPER PLAY
notes.content: Enhance player stats and get air support from a military drone that can aim and fire automatically!

notes.title: New update! - Drone and more🎉🕹️
notes.content:
In this new version, you can further improve your player's regeneration, armor, and speed, making your character more durable and efficient on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289375/7d2f17958553fc1c456e06db16371c3cc5278db4.gif[/img]

But that's not all. I've also introduced a new military drone that provides air support for you. The drone can aim and fire automatically, adding a new layer of strategy to the game and providing you with an even more thrilling and engaging experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289375/7550226fe317394574bdb770d4634d864236e6b4.gif[/img]

Thank you for your continued support, and I hope you have a great time!😊

This update⬆️fixes several gameplay bugs, such as unexpected crashes ❌🐞 and the removal of an area on all maps where enemies couldn't harm you 😊.

You can now add and upgrade a weapon on vehicles!

Today I added the Japanese language! Soon I will add Russian and German language.

Three new achievements have also been added:
[olist]
[*] Strong - Reach Level 5.

notes.title: New Achievements and Chinese and Spanish Languages!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Added 5 new achievements related to the number of enemies you have already defeated:

[olist]
[*] Killer - Defeat a total of 10 enemies.
[*] Murderer - Defeat a total of 100 enemies.
[*] Assassin - Defeat a total of 1.000 enemies.
[*] Slayer - Defeat a total of 10.000 enemies.
[*] Exterminator - Defeat a total of 100.000 enemies.
[/olist]

Now the game has a dedicated language screen. The new languages added were [b]Simplified Chinese and Spanish[/b].

More languages and achievements coming soon!

[/list]
